{{Top}}
{{Quote|I admit, the Tribe does have a certain fascination with glass, and with things of beauty in general.|Sith [[High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Shikkar.jpg|thumb|right|170px|A glass shikkar used by the Lost Tribe of Sith]]
'''Glass''' was a type of translucent or transparent material similar to [[clari-crystalline]]. This material was most often utilized by the rich on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with large [[City/Legends|cities]]. It was more prone to breakage than the stronger [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]. Those who had it installed, though, appreciated how glass offered a clearer view, favoring aesthetics over practicality. Unfortunately, even a slow-moving projectile would often be enough to shatter the entire pane into thousands of tiny, sharp fragments.

To install glass on worlds like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], workers would often use [[INS-444 window installation droid]]s to replace a pane; once installed, [[CLE-004 window cleaning droid/Legends|CLE-004 window cleaning droid]] units would clean and polish it.

Glass was installed in the [[Naboo Embassy]] in [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] on Coruscant. When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was visiting Coruscant, her room was outfitted with glass, which was shattered during an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempt]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].

The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to form glass [[Dagger/Legends|daggers]], called [[shikkar]]s. These daggers were plunged into the victim's body and then broke, embedding the blade in the being's flesh. The Tribe also used glass [[Parang/Legends|parangs]], tying in to the Lost Tribe [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] fascination with glass and other aesthetically pleasing objects. Glass could also be used for artistic purposes. The office of the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] had glass busts of previous holders of the title lined along the walls.
